name: Watanabe Shun
source:
The protagonist of this story.

He has a feminine appearance, but he is also feminine inside. He is a shy and timid boy who is not physically strong, and his grades are not so good. He was bullied as a child.

He is interested in women to a certain extent, but has never had any experience with a woman because he lacks courage. Perhaps because of his bullying nature, his teacher, Tsuzumi, has taken an interest in him.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_kyousi.htm]official site[/url]]
